Note: I have no knowledge of a published 2025 Kenya DHS with results for Bomet; the most recent Kenya DHS I know of is 2022. Bomet, a mid-income Rift Valley county, would likely fall near the national average (roughly mid-50s percent) for the menstrual hygiene indicator, with substantial county-level sampling uncertainty — hence the wide interval.
